[&_a]:border-current [&_strong]:text-current! text-blue-800 dark:text-blue-300" data-component-part="callout-content">This info is only applicable to the <code>gpt-oss-120b</code> model. </div></div>
<span data-as="p">For <code>gpt-oss-120b</code>, the API supports both the <code>system</code> and <code>developer</code> message roles. Both are mapped to a developer-level instruction layer in the prompt hierarchy, elevated above normal user instructions and injected into the model’s internal system prompt. This gives you significant control over the assistant’s tone, style, and behavior while preserving the model’s built-in safety guardrails.</span>
<span data-as="p">The <code>developer</code> role is functionally equivalent to <code>system</code> – the <code>system</code> role remains supported for backwards compatibility.</span>
<h3 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="key-differences-from-openai"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#key-differences-from-openai" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5" linecap="round" linejoin="round"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5" linecap="round" linejoin="round"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Key Differences from OpenAI</span></h3>
<span data-as="p">OpenAI’s API distinguishes between <code>system</code> and <code>developer</code> roles with different behavior. On Cerebras, both roles act at the developer level, meaning they may have stronger influence than <code>system</code> messages in OpenAI’s API.</span>
<span data-as="p">As a result, the same prompt may yield different behavior here compared to OpenAI. This is expected.</span>
<h2 class="flex whitespace-pre-wrap group font-semibold" id="unsupported-parameter-combinations"><div class="absolute" tabindex="-1"><a href="#unsupported-parameter-combinations" class="-ml-10 flex items-center opacity-0 border-0 group-hover:opacity-100 focus:opacity-100 focus:outline-0 group/link" aria-label="Navigate to header">​<div class="size-6 rounded-md flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs text-gray-400 dark:text-white/50 dark:bg-background-dark dark:brightness-[1.35] dark:ring-1 dark:hover:brightness-150 bg-white ring-1 ring-gray-400/30 dark:ring-gray-700/25 hover:ring-gray-400/60 dark:hover:ring-white/20 group-focus/link:border-2 group-focus/link:border-primary dark:group-focus/link:border-primary-light"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 18 18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true" class="size-3 shrink-0"><path d="M8.50001 6.827C8.14801 6.995 7.81801 7.225 7.52701 7.517L7.51701 7.527C6.13601 8.908 6.13601 11.146 7.51701 12.527L9.69201 14.702C11.073 16.083 13.311 16.083 14.692 14.702L14.702 14.692C16.083 13.311 16.083 11.073 14.702 9.692L13.771 8.761" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5" linecap="round" linejoin="round"></path><path d="M9.50002 11.173C9.85202 11.005 10.182 10.775 10.473 10.483L10.483 10.473C11.864 9.092 11.864 6.854 10.483 5.473L8.30802 3.298C6.92702 1.917 4.68902 1.917 3.30802 3.298L3.29802 3.308C1.91702 4.689 1.91702 6.927 3.29802 8.308L4.22902 9.239" stroke="currentColor" width="1.5" linecap="round" linejoin="round"></path></svg></div></a></div><span class="cursor-pointer">Unsupported Parameter Combinations</span></h2>
<span data-as="p">Support for combining <code>tools</code> and <code>response_format</code> is model-dependent. <code>gpt-oss-120b</code> rejects requests containing both fields. Other models may accept the combination but prioritize tool calling, so <code>response_format</code> should not be relied upon. For portable behavior across Cerebras models, use one of the following approaches:</span>
<ul>
<li><strong>Tool calling only</strong> — Omit <code>response_format</code> and let the model invoke tools. If you need structured arguments, define them in the tool’s <code>parameters</code> JSON schema, which the model will follow.</li>
<li><strong>Structured outputs only</strong> — Omit <code>tools</code> and use <code>response_format</code> with a JSON schema. See <a class="link" href="/capabilities/structured-outputs">Structured Outputs</a>.</li>
<li><strong>Two-step pipeline</strong> — Make a first call with <code>tools</code> to gather data, then make a second call with <code>response_format</code> to format the final result.</li>
</ul>
<span data-as="p">See <a class="link" href="/capabilities/tool-use">Tool Use</a> and <a class="link" href="/capabilities/structured-outputs">Structured Outputs</a> for details on each capability.</span>

<ul>
<li><strong>OpenAI</strong>: Non-standard parameters need to be passed through <code>extra_body</code>. Standard OpenAI parameters like <code>reasoning_effort</code> work directly.</li>
<li><strong>Cerebras SDK</strong>: Non-standard parameters can be passed in <strong>either</strong> <code>extra_body</code> <strong>or</strong> as regular parameters like <code>model</code>.</li>
</ul>

        const ts = this.timestamp();
        const logLine = `${ts} | ${level.padEnd(8)} | ${message}\n`;
        
        fs.appendFileSync(this.logFile, logLine);
        
        let coloredLevel = level;
        if (level === 'ERROR') coloredLevel = chalk.red(level);
        else if (level === 'SUCCESS') coloredLevel = chalk.green(level);
        else if (level === 'WARNING') coloredLevel = chalk.yellow(level);
        else if (level === 'INFO') coloredLevel = chalk.blue(level);
        
        console.log(`${chalk.green(ts)} | ${coloredLevel.padEnd(15)} | ${message}`);
    }

    info(message) { this.log('INFO', message); }
    success(message) { this.log('SUCCESS', message); }
    error(message) { this.log('ERROR', message); }
    warning(message) { this.log('WARNING', message); }
    debug(message) { this.log('DEBUG', message); }
}

/**
 * Load environment variables.
 */
function loadEnvVars() {
    // Try multiple locations
    const locations = [
        path.join(__dirname, '..', '..', '..', '.env'),
        path.join(__dirname, '..', '..', '.env'),
        path.join(process.cwd(), '.env'),
    ];
    
    for (const envPath of locations) {
        if (fs.existsSync(envPath)) {
            dotenv.config({ path: envPath, override: true });
            break;
        }
    }
    
    return process.env;
}

/**
 * Main test function.
 */
async function testDocs(integration, options) {
    // Setup logging
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '').substring(0, 15);
    const projectRoot = path.join(__dirname, '..', '..', '..');
    const logDir = path.join(projectRoot, '.log');
    const logFile = path.join(logDir, `${integration}_js_${timestamp}.log`);
    const logger = new Logger(logFile);

    logger.info('='.repeat(60));
    logger.info(`Testing JavaScript documentation for: ${integration}`);
    logger.info('='.repeat(60));

    // Find MDX file
    let mdxPath;
    if (options.docsPath) {
        mdxPath = path.join(options.docsPath, 'integrations', `${integration}.mdx`);
    } else {
        mdxPath = path.join(projectRoot, '..', 'cloned_repos', 'inference-docs', 'integrations', `${integration}.mdx`);
    }

    if (!fs.existsSync(mdxPath)) {
        logger.error(`Integration file not found: ${mdxPath}`);
        process.exit(1);
    }

    logger.info(`Found integration file: ${mdxPath}`);

    // Extract code snippets
    logger.info('Extracting code snippets...');
    const extractor = new MDXCodeExtractor(mdxPath);
    const jsSnippets = extractor.extractJavaScriptSnippets();
    const bashSnippets = extractor.extractBashSnippets();

    if (jsSnippets.length === 0) {
        logger.warning('No JavaScript code snippets found in the documentation');
        process.exit(0);
    }

    logger.info(`Extracted ${jsSnippets.length} JavaScript code snippets`);

    // Extract dependencies
    const dependencies = extractor.extractDependencies(bashSnippets);
    if (dependencies.length > 0) {
        logger.info(`Dependencies to install: ${dependencies.join(', ')}`);
    }

    // Load environment variables
    const envVars = loadEnvVars();

    // Create work directory
    const workDir = path.join(projectRoot, 'test_runs', `${integration}_js`);

    // Run tests
    const runner = new JavaScriptRunner(workDir, envVars, logger);
    const failFast = options.failFast && !options.noFailFast;

    let results;
    try {
        results = await runner.runAllTests(jsSnippets, dependencies, failFast);
    } finally {
        if (!options.keepWorkspace) {
            logger.info('\nCleaning up test workspace...');
            runner.cleanup();
        }
    }

    // Summary
    const total = results.length;
    const passed = results.filter(r => r.success).length;
    let failed = total - passed;

    if (total === 0) {
        logger.error('No extracted JavaScript or TypeScript snippets were executed');
        failed = 1;
    }

    if (options.outputJson) {
        const output = {
            integration,
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
            runtime: 'node',
            total,
            passed,
            failed,
            results: results.map(r => r.toDict())
        };
        console.log(JSON.stringify(output, indent=2));
    } else {
        logger.info('');
        logger.info('='.repeat(60));
        logger.info('TEST SUMMARY');
        logger.info('='.repeat(60));
        logger.info(`Total tests: ${total}`);
        logger.success(`Passed: ${passed}`);
        if (failed > 0) {
            logger.error(`Failed: ${failed}`);
            results.filter(r => !r.success).forEach(result => {
                logger.error(`  • ${result}`);
            });
        }
        logger.info(`\nFull log saved to: ${logFile}`);
    }

    process.exit(failed > 0 ? 1 : 0);
}

// CLI setup
const program = new Command();

program
    .name('docs-tester-js')
    .description('Test JavaScript code snippets from integration documentation')
    .argument('<integration>', 'Integration name (e.g., langchain, stagehand)')
    .option('--docs-path <path>', 'Path to inference-docs')
    .option('--output-json', 'Output results as JSON')
    .option('--keep-workspace', 'Keep test workspace after testing')
    .option('-v, --verbose', 'Enable verbose output')
    .option('-f, --fail-fast', 'Stop testing after first failure', true)
    .option('--no-fail-fast', 'Continue testing all snippets even after failures')
    .action(testDocs);

program.parse();
</script><script id="1" data-nscript="afterInteractive">/**
 * Extract JavaScript/TypeScript code snippets from MDX documentation files.
 */

import fs from 'fs';

/**
 * Represents a code snippet from documentation.
 */
export class CodeSnippet {
    constructor(content, lineNumber, snippetId, language = 'javascript') {
        this.content = content;
        this.lineNumber = lineNumber;
        this.snippetId = snippetId;
        this.language = language;
    }

    toString() {
        return `Snippet #${this.snippetId} (line ${this.lineNumber}, ${this.language})`;
    }
}

/**
 * Extract code blocks from MDX files.
 */
export class MDXCodeExtractor {
    constructor(mdxPath) {
        this.mdxPath = mdxPath;
        this.content = fs.readFileSync(mdxPath, 'utf-8');
    }

    /**
     * Extract all JavaScript/TypeScript code blocks from the MDX file.
     */
    extractJavaScriptSnippets() {
        const snippets = [];
        
        // Pattern to match JS/TS code blocks
        // Use \b to ensure we don't match "json" as "js"
        const pattern = /```(javascript|js|typescript|ts)\b\s*\n(.*?)```/gs;
        
        let snippetCount = 0;
        let match;
        
        while ((match = pattern.exec(this.content)) !== null) {
            const language = match[1];
            let code = match[2];
            
            // Find line number
            const matchStart = match.index;
            const lineNumber = this.content.substring(0, matchStart).split('\n').length;
            
            // Clean up code
            code = this._cleanCode(code);
            
            if (!code.trim()) {
                continue;
            }
            
            snippetCount++;
            snippets.push(new CodeSnippet(
                code,
                lineNumber,
                snippetCount,
                language
            ));
        }
        
        return snippets;
    }

    /**
     * Extract bash code blocks (for npm install commands).
     */
    extractBashSnippets() {
        const snippets = [];
        const pattern = /```bash\s*[^\n]*\n(.*?)```/gs;
        
        let snippetCount = 0;
        let match;
        
        while ((match = pattern.exec(this.content)) !== null) {
            const code = match[1];
            const matchStart = match.index;
            const lineNumber = this.content.substring(0, matchStart).split('\n').length;
            
            // Only include if it has npm install
            if (code.includes('npm install') || code.includes('npm i ') || code.includes('yarn add')) {
                snippetCount++;
                snippets.push(new CodeSnippet(
                    code,
                    lineNumber,
                    snippetCount,
                    'bash'
                ));
            }
        }
        
        return snippets;
    }

    /**
     * Clean and dedent code.
     */
    _cleanCode(code) {
        let lines = code.split('\n');
        
        // Remove leading/trailing empty lines
        while (lines.length && !lines[0].trim()) {
            lines.shift();
        }
        while (lines.length && !lines[lines.length - 1].trim()) {
            lines.pop();
        }
        
        if (!lines.length) {
            return '';
        }
        
        // Find minimum indentation
        let minIndent = Infinity;
        for (const line of lines) {
            if (line.trim()) {
                const indent = line.length - line.trimStart().length;
                minIndent = Math.min(minIndent, indent);
            }
        }
        
        // Remove common indentation
        if (minIndent !== Infinity && minIndent > 0) {
            lines = lines.map(line => 
                line.length > minIndent ? line.substring(minIndent) : line
            );
        }
        
        return lines.join('\n');
    }

    /**
     * Extract package dependencies from npm install commands.
     */
    extractDependencies(bashSnippets) {
        const dependencies = new Set();
        
        for (const snippet of bashSnippets) {
            for (const line of snippet.content.split('\n')) {
                if (line.includes('npm install') || line.includes('npm i ')) {
                    // Extract package names
                    const parts = line
                        .replace(/npm install|npm i/, '')
                        .trim()
                        .split(/\s+/);
                    
                    for (const part of parts) {
                        if (part && !part.startsWith('-')) {
                            dependencies.add(part);
                        }
                    }
                } else if (line.includes('yarn add')) {
                    const parts = line
                        .replace('yarn add', '')
                        .trim()
                        .split(/\s+/);
                    
                    for (const part of parts) {
                        if (part && !part.startsWith('-')) {
                            dependencies.add(part);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        return Array.from(dependencies);
    }
}

 * Test runner for JavaScript/TypeScript code snippets.
 */

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { execSync, spawn } from 'child_process';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'url';

const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = path.dirname(__filename);

/**
 * Result of running a code snippet test.
 */
export class TestResult {
    constructor(snippet, success, stdout, stderr, errorMessage = null) {
        this.snippet = snippet;
        this.success = success;
        this.stdout = stdout;
        this.stderr = stderr;
        this.errorMessage = errorMessage;
    }

    toString() {
        const status = this.success ? '✓ PASSED' : '✗ FAILED';
        return `${status} | ${this.snippet}`;
    }

    toDict() {
        return {
            snippetId: this.snippet.snippetId,
            lineNumber: this.snippet.lineNumber,
            language: this.snippet.language,
            success: this.success,
            errorMessage: this.errorMessage,
        };
    }
}

/**
 * Run JavaScript/TypeScript code snippets.
 */
export class JavaScriptRunner {
    constructor(workDir, envVars, logger) {
        this.workDir = workDir;
        this.envVars = envVars;
        this.logger = logger;
        
        // Create work directory
        if (!fs.existsSync(workDir)) {
            fs.mkdirSync(workDir, { recursive: true });
        }
    }

    /**
     * Install dependencies in the work directory.
     */
    installDependencies(dependencies) {
        if (!dependencies.length) {
            return true;
        }

        this.logger.info(`Installing dependencies: ${dependencies.join(', ')}`);

        // Create package.json if it doesn't exist
        const packageJsonPath = path.join(this.workDir, 'package.json');
        if (!fs.existsSync(packageJsonPath)) {
            fs.writeFileSync(packageJsonPath, JSON.stringify({
                name: 'docs-test',
                type: 'module',
                dependencies: {}
            }, null, 2));
        }

        try {
            execSync(`npm install ${dependencies.join(' ')}`, {
                cwd: this.workDir,
                stdio: 'pipe',
                timeout: 300000
            });
            this.logger.success(`✓ Installed: ${dependencies.join(', ')}`);
            return true;
        } catch (error) {
            this.logger.error(`Failed to install dependencies: ${error.message}`);
            return false;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Run a single code snippet.
     */
    async runSnippet(snippet) {
        // Determine file extension based on language
        const ext = snippet.language.includes('typescript') || snippet.language === 'ts' 
            ? '.ts' 
            : '.js';
        
        const tempFile = path.join(this.workDir, `snippet_${snippet.snippetId}${ext}`);
        
        // Write snippet to file
        fs.writeFileSync(tempFile, snippet.content);

        try {
            // Prepare environment
            const env = { ...process.env, ...this.envVars };

            // Use tsx for TypeScript, node for JavaScript
            const runner = ext === '.ts' ? 'npx tsx' : 'node';
            
            return await new Promise((resolve) => {
                const child = spawn(runner, [tempFile], {
                    cwd: this.workDir,
                    env,
                    shell: true,
                    timeout: 60000
                });

                let stdout = '';
                let stderr = '';
                let timeoutId;
                const finish = (result) => {
                    if (timeoutId) {
                        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
                    }
                    resolve(result);
                };

                child.stdout.on('data', (data) => {
                    stdout += data.toString();
                });

                child.stderr.on('data', (data) => {
                    stderr += data.toString();
                });

                child.on('close', (code) => {
                    const success = code === 0;
                    let errorMessage = null;

                    // Check for error patterns
                    const output = stdout + stderr;
                    const errorPatterns = {
                        'Error:': 'Runtime error',
                        'TypeError:': 'Type error',
                        'ReferenceError:': 'Reference error',
                        'SyntaxError:': 'Syntax error',
                        'Cannot find module': 'Missing module',
                    };

                    for (const [pattern, description] of Object.entries(errorPatterns)) {
                        if (output.includes(pattern)) {
                            errorMessage = description;
                            break;
                        }
                    }

                    if (!success && !errorMessage) {
                        errorMessage = stderr || 'Unknown error';
                    }

                    finish(new TestResult(
                        snippet,
                        success && !errorMessage,
                        stdout,
                        stderr,
                        errorMessage
                    ));
                });

                child.on('error', (error) => {
                    finish(new TestResult(
                        snippet,
                        false,
                        '',
                        '',
                        `Execution error: ${error.message}`
                    ));
                });

                // Timeout handling
                timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
                    child.kill();
                    finish(new TestResult(
                        snippet,
                        false,
                        stdout,
                        stderr,
                        'Execution timed out (60s limit)'
                    ));
                }, 60000);
            });
        } catch (error) {
            return new TestResult(
                snippet,
                false,
                '',
                '',
                `Unexpected error: ${error.message}`
            );
        } finally {
            if (fs.existsSync(tempFile)) {
                fs.unlinkSync(tempFile);
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Run all snippets.
     */
    async runAllTests(snippets, dependencies, failFast = true) {
        const results = [];

        // Filter to JS/TS snippets only
        const jsSnippets = snippets.filter(s => 
            ['javascript', 'js', 'typescript', 'ts'].includes(s.language)
        );

        if (!jsSnippets.length) {
            this.logger.warning('No JavaScript/TypeScript snippets found to test');
            return results;
        }

        this.logger.info(`Found ${jsSnippets.length} JavaScript/TypeScript snippets to test`);

        // Install dependencies
        if (dependencies.length) {
            if (!this.installDependencies(dependencies)) {
                const errorMessage = 'Dependency installation failed';
                this.logger.error(errorMessage);
                return jsSnippets.map(snippet => new TestResult(
                    snippet,
                    false,
                    '',
                    '',
                    errorMessage
                ));
            }
        }

        // Run each snippet
        for (const snippet of jsSnippets) {
            this.logger.info(`\nRunning ${snippet}`);

            const result = await this.runSnippet(snippet);
            results.push(result);

            if (result.success) {
                this.logger.success(`${result}`);
                if (result.stdout) {
                    this.logger.debug(`Output: ${result.stdout.substring(0, 200)}`);
                }
            } else {
                this.logger.error(`${result}`);
                this.logger.error(`Error: ${result.errorMessage}`);
                if (result.stderr) {
                    this.logger.error(`Stderr: ${result.stderr}`);
                }
                if (result.stdout) {
                    this.logger.info(`Stdout: ${result.stdout}`);
                }

                if (failFast) {
                    this.logger.warning('Stopping tests (fail-fast mode)');
                    return results;
                }
            }
        }

        return results;
    }

    /**
     * Clean up work directory.
     */
    cleanup() {
        if (fs.existsSync(this.workDir)) {
            fs.rmSync(this.workDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
        }
    }
}
